messages:
alex: We discovered a late-ingest hot shard affecting hourly_agg for 2026-02-10 -> 2026-02-12. Need a controlled recompute to avoid spiking console metrics.

maria: What's the schedule? we can't hammer analytics workers during business hours.

alex: Proposal: start 02:00 UTC tomorrow, 5 waves, 3-hour window each, concurrency 3 shards/wave, batch 4k events/min. Aim to keep dashboard latency impact < 5%.

sam: Can we put the biggest tenants into a low-priority lane? Last time a single tenant consumed all reindex IO.

jordan: Yep. We'll use tenant gating. Config idea: top-ten tenants get explicit caps, others use a default. Example snippet below.

liz: Also recommend automated backoff if dashboard tail latency > 7% for 5m. Should reduce concurrency by 1 and add 2min cool-off.

alex: Backoff behavior accepted. Example replay command (draft):
```
replayctl run --job hourly_agg_recompute --window 2026-02-10T00:00Z/2026-02-12T23:59Z \
  --waves 5 --concurrency 3 --batch 4000 --tenant-quota config://tenant_quota_map \
  --backoff-threshold 0.07 --backoff-step 1 --pause-min 2
```

replay-bot: Scheduler note: progress pings will be posted in #eng-platform at wave start/end.

maria: Console needs per-wave controls: cancel, pause, and a small sampler of logs. We need to be able to cancel only a single wave without affecting queued waves.

alex: UI PR in flight. Design question: show live sampled logs inline or link out to logs view?

liz: Live 30s sample + link is my vote. Real-time logs help quick triage, but full logs belong in ops view.

sam: Also: any recompute-driven model inference or feature pipelines should be labeled as background so cost/alerting excludes them.

jordan: Router change required: add rule for header `x-recompute=true` -> route to background pool. We'll add a route.rule entry.

alex: Internal API decision: should replay jobs write directly to telemetry write API or emit to the ingestion topic?

maria: Topic -> full pipeline maintains validation and dedupe. Direct-write is faster but bypasses checks. I'd prefer topic for safety.

liz: Agreed. We'll replay -> ingestion-topic, then enable a fast-path canary consumer to validate shape for the first two waves. If shape looks good, scale normal consumers.

jordan: Tenant gating config (to land in repo):
```
{"tenant_quota_map": {"tenant:bigco": "0.25", "tenant:acme": "0.15"}, "default": "0.05"}
```

alex: Console telemetry card request: progress bar, waves completed/total, current throughput, last error message, ETA. Include per-wave cancel/pause buttons. product-ops, can you spec this?

product-ops: Will add a lightweight spec in #product-ops today. Will include wire, actions (cancel/pause/retry), and perms.

sam: Finance: tag replay traffic with cost-tag `recompute_background` so it doesn't skew product alerts. I'll validate billing tags before run.

alex: Ops runbook checklist before kickoff: push replay config to staging & run smoke, deploy router rule in staging, enable canary consumer, Console UI basic controls merged, add scheduler backoff and slack hooks.

maria: I can validate staging run at 22:00 UTC tonight. Ping me when config is up.

liz: I'll implement slack alert when tail latency > 5% (urgent). Also add automatic rollback: if backoff triggers 3x in a row, stop job and notify oncall.

sam: I'll confirm cost-tagging and ensure finance has briefed thresholds.

alex: Final: I will open PRs for replay config, router rule, and basic Console UI. We'll kick waves subject to green staging check and product-ops signoff. I'll post replay-bot updates here as waves progress. :thumbsup:

replay-bot: Wave 1 scheduled for 2026-02-15T02:00:00Z. Monitoring channel: #eng-platform. Good luck! :rocket:
